questions.passage: Is there other evidence that shows the long-term effect of experiencing natural disasters on victims’ values and occupational preferences? questions.prompt: What evidence was examined in the Kobe–Tokyo comparison?
options: Only personal interviews with the same schoolchildren.
Municipal job-application trends from 1989 to 2000.
Applications to every private company worldwide.
Hospital records from the 1906 earthquake.
optionsZh: 只访问同一批小学生。
1989–2000市政职位申请趋势。
全球所有私企申请。
1906地震医院记录。

Ruined buildings literally contain hidden gold.
Every survivor must feel grateful for disaster.

questions.passage: Did an unusual experience of COVID-19 increase psychological richness? Micael Dahlen and Helge Thorbjørnsen directly tested this question. During the second week of April 2021, 973 Swedes anonymously filled out a questionnaire that asked about their COVID-19 status as well as whether they felt they were living a psychologically rich life.
